scope: read-only source and metadata audit; records and validator only

storage.get: Redis GET exact UUID-derived key; absent key returns history null; no TTL refresh
storage.put: read existing record then Redis SET exact key with EX=7776000; refreshes expiry and preserves existing createdAt
storage.delete: Redis DEL exact key; no wildcard or global deletion
storage.concurrency: server read-then-set last-write-wins; no version check or compare-and-set
storage.storageUnavailable: GET, PUT and DELETE each return HTTP 503 {ok:false,error:history_unavailable}; no fallback persistence

environment.contract: server requires one URL and one token; UPSTASH_* preferred independently via nullish coalescing, KV_* fallback; missing either returns 503
environment.localBasis: current process keys absent and no local .env file; .env.example contains placeholders only
environment.metadataReason: Vercel CLI unavailable; available connector has no dedicated environment-name/target listing; no secret-bearing project or environment response requested
environment.clientExposureBasis: server-only process.env references; no NEXT_PUBLIC history credential reference, history response, browser fixture, or compiled .next/static match for credential names

privacy.conversationId: anonymous browser-generated UUID v4 in localStorage; server UUID validated; no account/payment/entitlement binding
privacy.conversationIdCaveat: UUID acts as bearer lookup capability and appears in GET/DELETE query string; holders can read/delete that conversation; typed message content can contain user-supplied personal data
privacy.recommendedWorkId: assistant only, nonempty trimmed string <=180, exact merged Canonical Catalog ID on PUT and GET; unknown/stale ID removed while text stays; latest assistant card rebuilt without selection or title fallback
privacy.logging: history route logs raw caught error object; message body, conversationId and credential are not intentionally logged, but exception-field leakage is unproven

findings.evidence: chat.tsx queueHistoryDeletion ignores non-2xx DELETE and exceptions; forgetConversation and memory-off paths show deletion/stopped toast even if Redis DEL fails
findings.remediation: Require confirmed DELETE ok before claiming removal; preserve the ID and retry path on failure

findings.evidence: writeChatHistory reads then SETs whole record without CAS/version; client serialization is per browser instance only
findings.remediation: Define and implement server conflict policy or atomic/versioned writes before production activation

findings.evidence: API catch logs raw error object; provider exception fields have not been proven free of request/credential data
findings.remediation: Log a bounded error category without raw exception fields

findings.evidence: 40 messages and 2000 characters per message bound persisted content; history route has no explicit HTTP body byte limit, and recommendedWorkId is z.unknown before normalization
findings.remediation: Set explicit body byte bound and validate ID type/length before catalog load

findings.evidence: GET and DELETE rely on knowledge of UUID; ID is stored in browser localStorage and sent in URL query
findings.remediation: Review threat model and privacy notice, including URL/request logging

findings.evidence: Production and Preview env name/target presence could not be inspected without a safe metadata-only tool
findings.remediation: Use a reviewed names-and-targets-only Vercel metadata listing

validation.strengthening02Browser: PASS 13/13; F8 new/legacy/invalid, F9 503, F10 stale; provider calls 0; external requests blocked 22
validation.scopedLint: PASS: audit validator .mjs, 0 errors, 0 warnings (existing .eslintignore deprecation notice)

truthBoundary: Source and local synthetic fixtures establish contracts only. Fixture PASS is not Production Redis reliability; env presence is not connectivity; connectivity would not prove customer-data correctness; local HEAD Production parity is unverified.
nextGate: Fix DELETE acknowledgement and define concurrency/logging/body-limit safeguards, then obtain safe Vercel env-name/target metadata and reassess; no Production history data access or deploy in this gate
